title: U32 vector growth capacity
summary: Recovered pure thiscall capacity selector at VA 0x50dfe0: wrapping address difference, arithmetic shift by two, unsigned half-capacity growth and overflow fallback to the requested count. Original instructions and four allocation callers inspected directly.
test_description: Direct GCC i386 thiscall differential comparisons against the original at 0x50dfe0: 1216 edge combinations, 97280 small-capacity/request combinations, and 100000 deterministic random address triples and requests. Includes zero, odd capacities, signed-difference boundary, address wrap, unaligned differences, full-width requests and growth fallback. Both objects' three fields and surrounding canaries must remain unchanged.
known_limits: Address fields model the original 32-bit ABI; a native pointer-owning vector integration is outside this routine.
Synthetic malformed triples characterize machine arithmetic only, not valid allocation or container behavior.
No allocation, caller exceptions, or whole-game behavior is recovered; no matching-byte claim.
